edition: The Potent Self, original 1985; reference edition North Atlantic/Frog 2002, ISBN 9781583940686. No complete edition read. Spanish official sample identifies original work and translators.
criticalBridge: Competing motivations persist as habitual muscular organization; relearning consists in discriminating those effects while trying graded alternatives, checking breathing and reversibility, anticipating/enacting movement, and recognizing transfer rather than simply repeating or imposing a pose.
